HIV Gene Expression Data

hivdata.Rd

The data comprises 7680 z-values, each relating to a two-sample t-test. The test compares gene expression values for 4 HIV patients with values for 4 normal subjects; the t-score `T[i]` for gene i has been transformed to a normal scale, `z[i] = qnorm(pt(T[i], df=6))`, so that the `z[i]`'s theoretically would have a standard \(N(0,1)\) distribution under the null hypothesis.

Usage

hivdata

Format

A numeric vector containing 7680 z-values.

References

van't Wout, et al., Cellular gene expression upon human immunodeficiency virus type 1 infection of CD4+-T-Cell lines, Journal of Virology 77, 1392-1402.

Examples

data(hivdata)
hist(hivdata, breaks = 100)
